pkg.lyricsBlock:
[Whispered Narration Intro]
(soft sogeum airy breath, distant gayageum harmonics and melancholic ajaeng drone, signature hook melody introduced in first 10 seconds)

깊이 녹아든 너의 미소가 still shakes me
아직도 나를 흔들어 놓지만 now I let go

[Verse 1]
(low ajaeng sustained notes with delicate gayageum plucks, subtle janggu rhythm evoking farewell)

익숙한 선율과 coffee scent에
꿈꾸듯 마음이 melt away
아직 넌 내 맘 구석에 hold on tight

[Pre-Chorus]
(gayageum arpeggio rising with pain, ajaeng glissando, percussion layering slowly, taepyeongso soft emotional tease)

괜찮다며 눈물로 지샌 밤에
your warmth never fades away

[BUILD]
(janggu & buk rolls increasing density, ajaeng pitch rising, deep sub bass rumble growing, sogeum ornamentation building heavy tension)

[DROP]
(silence 0.6sec → immediate heavy punch: deep sub bass + janggu/buk powerful hit, taepyeongso lead dominates with soaring emotional melody full of release, gayageum rhythm flowing through)

네가 남긴 scars even become light
영혼의 빛이 되어 heal me now
상처를 감싸 날 일으켜
나는 다시 rise again

[Chorus]
(full traditional fusion groove, bright female vocal with deep healing emotion, male deep low harmony anchoring sorrow and release)

네가 남긴 scars even become light
영혼의 빛이 되어 heal me now
상처를 감싸 날 일으켜
나는 다시 rise again tonight

[Verse 2]
(softer ajaeng long tones, gayageum delicate strums, male low vocal adding heavy acceptance)

네 곁에 보이는 낯선 shadow
다른 shoulder에 기대어 웃는 you
내 영혼은 무참히 break apart

[Rap Break]
(male deep aggressive rhythmic rap, driving janggu & buk with afrobeat groove, ajaeng low painful stabs, taepyeongso short intense motifs)

Yo, last cafe where your scent still lingers in the air
Your smile haunts me but I gotta let it go right there
Ajaeng cries the pieces of my broken soul
Taepyeongso screams the truth I finally know
Bass drop heavy like the weight I carried too long
Now the scars become light, turning pain into a song

[BUILD 2]
(denser percussion layers, rising taepyeongso wail with trills, full sub bass swell, maximum emotional release tension)

[DROP 2]
(immediate heavy impact, taepyeongso lead stronger with soaring melody, full percussion explosion, female emotional adlib)

네가 남긴 scars even become light
영혼의 빛이 되어 heal me now
상처를 감싸 날 일으켜
나는 다시 rise again

[Final Chorus]
(maximum energy, layered male & female vocals, full instrumentation with powerful hook repetition)

네가 남긴 scars even become light
영혼의 빛이 되어 heal me now
상처를 감싸 날 일으켜
나는 다시 rise again tonight
미워하는 마음도 love I used to know
차가운 바람 조차도 soft and warm
다신 흔들리지 않아 no more tears
네가 남긴 scars even become light
영혼의 빛이 되어
나는 다시 rise again

[Outro]
(fade with sogeum soft air, lingering gayageum harmonics and resolving ajaeng drone, whispered male "new soul... I rise again")
pkg.sunoStyle:
Korean traditional fusion EDM with afrobeat groove.
Instruments: gayageum, ajaeng, taepyeongso, sogeum, janggu, buk, kkwaenggwari, jing.
Bass: deep sub bass, strong, punchy, clean from kick.
Drums: afrobeat groove + Korean traditional rhythm.
Drop: instant hit after build, bass + Korean percussion dominate. Taepyeongso or ajaeng lead within 0.3 sec. Kkwaenggwari for tension only, jing for resonance.
Vocal: female bright and emotional. male deep, thick, heavy and resonant.
Male rap: aggressive, rhythmic, low-register English rap.
Structure: build → drop → chorus. 100-110 BPM.
Atmosphere: traditional + modern + cinematic Joseon night vibe.
Restrictions: no modern synth lead, no weak bass, no thin vocal, traditional instruments must remain clearly recognizable.
